description: Defines the Scope class used for script execution and build configuration management in GN build system, including scope nesting, variable management, templates, and properties.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Manages variable scopes for script execution, supporting nested scopes, variable access, templates, properties, and build dependencies.

classes.name: Scope::ProgrammaticProvider
classes.description: Provides a mechanism for programmatically generating scope values, registered with a Scope.

classes.name: Scope::MergeOptions
classes.description: Configures options for merging scopes, including clobbering existing variables, skipping private vars, marking destination as used, and excluding certain variables.

classes.name: Scope::TemplateInvocationEntry
classes.description: Stores information about a template invocation, including template name, target name, and location.

methods.name: Scope::DetachFromContaining
methods.description: Clears references to containing scopes, making the scope self-sufficient.

methods.name: Scope::HasValues
methods.description: Checks if the scope has any set values, optionally searching nested scopes.

methods.name: Scope::GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value by identifier, with options to consider usage and scope.

methods.name: Scope::GetMutableValue
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to a value if it exists in a mutable scope.

methods.name: Scope::SetValue
methods.description: Sets a variable's value in the current scope, with associated parse node for error reporting.

methods.name: Scope::RemoveIdentifier
methods.description: Removes a variable from the current scope.

methods.name: Scope::AddTemplate
methods.description: Associates a template with the scope.

methods.name: Scope::GetTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template by name, searching recursively.

methods.name: Scope::MarkUsed
methods.description: Marks a variable as used.

methods.name: Scope::CheckForUnusedVars
methods.description: Checks for variables set but not used, reporting errors.

methods.name: Scope::GetCurrentScopeValues
methods.description: Retrieves all variables set in the current scope.

methods.name: Scope::NonRecursiveMergeTo
methods.description: Merges current scope's values into another scope without recursion.

methods.name: Scope::MakeClosure
methods.description: Creates a copy of the scope suitable for closures.

methods.name: Scope::SetProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Flags the scope as processing a build configuration file.

methods.name: Scope::SetProcessingImport
methods.description: Flags the scope as processing an import file.

methods.name: Scope::GetSourceDir
methods.description: Returns the source directory associated with the scope.

methods.name: Scope::AddBuildDependencyFile
methods.description: Adds a build dependency file to the scope.

methods.name: Scope::CollectBuildDependencyFiles
methods.description: Collects all build dependency files from the scope and its parents.

methods.name: Scope::GetItemCollector
methods.description: Returns the item collector for the scope.

methods.name: Scope::SetProperty
methods.description: Sets an opaque property on the scope.

methods.name: Scope::GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property, searching recursively.

methods.name: Scope::SetTemplateInvocationEntry
methods.description: Records a template invocation for debugging.

methods.name: Scope::GetTemplateInvocationEntries
methods.description: Returns the stack of template invocations leading to this scope.
